explanation: data/expression/visium/README.md now follows HYPOMAP's conventions. Region names, the absence of a minimum-spot or sparse rule, and pooling every spot to summarise a region follow the HYPOMAP authors (Tadross et al. 2025, Supplementary Table 20 and Methods). Groups are the authors' 23 grouped regional clusters, named from their abbreviation table; all 143 donor x region cells are samples; no compartments; Unassigned is kept but not ranked, as the authors assign no region when Unassigned comes out on top. A region's value is pooled (CPM of all its spots summed across donors and sections) through per-condition poolWeights. The R 4.6.0 re-extraction record is unchanged.
